roleTitle: Financial Crime Data Analyst, Transaction Screening
jobDescription: The transaction screening team tunes and monitors the sanctions and payment screening rules for the bank's payment flows. The Financial Crime Data Analyst analyses the screening alert outcomes, proposes rule and list changes with their expected alert volumes, prepares the monthly screening effectiveness pack, presents proposals to the screening governance forum, and documents each change's boundaries. Rule changes are approved by the forum. The role requires defending proposals in the forum when the compliance members challenge them. Reports to the head of screening analytics; works with the screening operations team, compliance and the list management vendor.
requirements: Analyses screening alert outcomes and proposes rule and list changes with expected alert volumes.
Prepares the monthly screening effectiveness pack under the pack standard.
Presents proposals to the screening governance forum and answers the compliance members' challenges.
Coordinates rule changes with screening operations, with approval staying with the forum, and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents each change's limitations and hand-over conditions.

evidence.text: Financial crime data analyst in a bank's transaction screening team for three years, analysing the screening alert outcomes each week and proposing rule and list changes with their expected alert volumes.
Prepared the monthly screening effectiveness pack under the pack standard, with the packs filed in the screening governance repository.

Presented twenty-seven proposals to the screening governance forum; the forum minutes record the compliance members' challenges on each and the forum's decision, with twenty-two proposals approved as presented and five amended.
Coordinated the approved rule changes with the screening operations team through the change note, recording which checks were mine and which were operations'; the approvals were the forum's.
Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each change note.

Work sample: two proposals with their forum minutes and decisions, one monthly screening effectiveness pack and one change note with its limitation section, with the governance repository references as a verification trail.

Interviewer 2 note: when the panel's compliance member challenged the sample proposal's false-positive estimate, the candidate named the two months the estimate came from, gave the alert counts for each, stated which count she would use if the forum preferred the conservative one, and left the estimate range on the slide rather than changing the number.

Reference call with the former head of screening analytics: confirmed the candidate presented the proposals to the forum in the period, that approvals stayed with the forum, and confirmed the employment dates.
